noUploadHeader: Apply for your free Coursera license
noUploadDescription: Through Kiron, you can obtain the Coursera for Impact license for refugees, asylum seekers and people under international protection. A short verification gives you access to your free Coursera license — unlimited certified courses from Stanford, Yale, Google and 300+ partners.
noUploadNote: The license is subject to change and depends on Coursera availability.
inReviewDescription: Thank you for uploading your document. We are now reviewing it and you will receive an email from us in the next few weeks.
inReviewDescriptionComment: We are a small team, so reviewing your documents might take some time. Please refrain from messaging us about when you will get verified - we will get back to you!
invalidUploadHeader: Oops, it looks like that wasn't the right document
invalidUploadDescription: Make sure you understand Kiron’s eligibility criteria and click on re-upload document below to submit your new document. On the next page, you will see examples of accepted documents.
rejectedHeader: Your document could not be verified
rejectedDescription: Apologies, we can't verify the uploaded document. You can still access Kiron's free programs. For questions, contact student-support@kiron.ngo
acceptedDescription: Enjoy our learning programs on the Explore page or meet other learners in your area on the Community page.
ineligibleUploadHeader: Thank you for submitting your documents!
ineligibleUploadDescription: Our team has reviewed them, and unfortunately, you are not eligible for full access to Kiron’s catalog. You can still access our basic courses and resources and will continue to receive relevant communications from us. Please note that reapplying is not possible at the moment.
documentCheckClosed: Kiron has introduced a new system for periodic documentation verification and eligibility criteria. You still have access to the Kiron Campus and will continue to receive messages from us, unless you unsubscribe. Offers to certain courses and programs are available only to verified learners. Read more about the new process on
verifiedDescription: Unlimited certified courses from Coursera's 300+ partners — yours, on Kiron and Coursera.
pendingDescription: We're checking your document. You'll get an email within 3 working days. In the meantime, all Kiron-hosted courses are open to you.
cycleClosedHeader: Coursera for Impact — applications open in rounds
cycleClosedDescription: Verification for the free Coursera for Impact license opens in rounds through the year. When the next round opens and you're eligible, we'll notify you here and by email.
